comparison.objective: Dilute concentrated acid by pouring acid into water in the safe order; detailed rubric is absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled liquid pouring and spill/order management, not bimanual mandrel stabilization, hammer impact or tiny-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Correct transfer direction with implied safe containment; quantities and spill thresholds are missing. Candidate requires four notch fractures and recovery of every tang without damage.
comparison.reason: Fluid transfer safety is meaningfully different from contact-loaded insert finishing.
